chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ قُولَوَيْهَ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُسْمَعِيِّ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَسْبَاطٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashshi: Muhammad ibn Qulawayh, from Sa'd, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa and Muhammad ibn Abdallah al-Mismai, from Ali ibn Asbat, from Muhammad ibn Abdallah ibn Zurara, from his father who said:

chunks.arabic_text: بَعَثَ زُرَارَةٌ عُبَيْدًا ابْنَهُ يَسْأَلُ عَنْ خَبَرِ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ فَجَاءَهُ الْمَوْتُ قَبْلَ رُجُوعِ عُبَيْدٍ إِلَيْهِ فَأَخَذَ الْمُصْحَفَ فَأَعْلَاهُ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِ وَقَالَ: إِنَّ الْإِمَامَ بَعْدَ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ اسْمُهُ بَيْنَ الدَّفَّتَيْنِ فِي جُمْلَةِ الْقُرْآنِ مَنْصُوصٌ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الَّذِينَ أَوْجَبَ اللَّهُ طَاعَتَهُمْ عَلَى خَلْقِهِ، أَنَا مُؤْمِنٌ بِهِ قَالَ: فَأُخْبِرَ بِذَلِكَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ الْأَوَّلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ فَقَالَ: وَاللَّهُ كَانَ زُرَارَةٌ مُهَاجِرًا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى

translations.en: Zurara sent his son Ubayd to ask about the affair of Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), but death came to him before Ubayd returned to him. So he took the Mushaf and placed it above his head and said: 'The Imam after Ja'far ibn Muhammad is the one whose name is between the two covers in the generality of the Qur'an, designated among those whose obedience Allah has made obligatory upon His creation, and I am a believer in him.' It was said: 'That was informed to Abu al-Hasan (the first) (peace be upon him), so he said: By Allah, Zurara was an emigrant to Allah the Exalted.'

en.summary: This narrative from Rijal al-Kashshi recounts the death of the prominent companion Zurara, who placed the Qur'an above his head and declared that the Imam after Ja'far al-Sadiq is the one whose name is mentioned in the Qur'an among those whose obedience is obligatory. The first Imam, Abu al-Hasan, confirmed this, praising Zurara as a true emigrant to God. This event highlights the Shia belief in the explicit designation (Nass) of Imams within the Qur'anic text, reinforcing the authority of the Ahl al-Bayt.
en.seo_question: What did Zurara say about the Imam after Ja'far ibn Muhammad before his death?

key_terms.زُرَارَة: Zurara, a prominent companion of the Imams
key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ: Abu al-Hasan, referring to Imam Musa al-Kadhim
key_terms.بَيْنَ الدَّفَّتَيْنِ: Between the two covers, referring to the Qur'an
key_terms.مُهَاجِرًا: Emigrant, one who migrates for the sake of God
